TCS Q1 Earnings Preview: Revenue Flat, Margins Under Pressure

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is set to release its first-quarter earnings, with analysts anticipating flat revenue growth. Wage increases are expected to impact profit margins, while the company faces challenges from AI disruption and reduced client spending. This quarter is seen as a significant test for CEO Krithivasan.
